{{Top|leg}}
'''Aivela's Crest''' was a location within the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], named after [[Aivela]], one of Zakuulan [[Six Gods|Old Gods]]. At one point during their romantic relationship, the Immortal [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] sang to [[Senya Tirall]] on Aivela's Crest.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I've never forgotten. How you sang to me on Aivela's Crest.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>}}
Aivela's Crest is only mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' if the player makes a Dark Side choice, leading to Senya's death on [[Voss]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
